standing: Leads the AFC East by 4 games

lastGame.title: Bills 26, Dolphins 9
stats: Josh Allen: 27-of-45, 304 yards, 1 TD, 2 INT; threw to eight different receivers and had no rushing attempts
DJ Moore: 8 catches, 91 yards, 4-yard TD; Khalil Shakir 5 catches for 101 yards; Ty Johnson 7 catches for 55 yards
James Cook III: 89 rushing yards and a 1-yard TD, his 10th rushing TD of the season
Tyler Bass: 4-of-5 on field goals (54, 43, 40, 28); a 54-yard miss ended his streak of 33 straight makes
Defense: 185 yards allowed, Miami 2-of-14 on third down, Kyle McCord 12-of-33 for 102 yards; Greg Rousseau 2 sacks, Damar Hamlin INT; no TD allowed since Nov 1

news.h: Benford out of Monday's estimated practice report
news.b: Buffalo did not practice Monday but issued an estimated injury report for Thursday's game against Kansas City. CB Christian Benford (groin), who missed Sunday's win over Miami, was listed as not practicing. Final game designations are due Wednesday at 4 p.m. for the Thursday game.

Greg Rousseau (back), TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb, ankle), RT Spencer Brown (back), S Damar Hamlin (toe, neck), DL T.J. Sanders (shoulder), RG O'Cyrus Torrance (ankle) and LB Dorian Williams (calf) were listed as limited on the estimated report. Ed Oliver (oblique), Cole Bishop, Amani Hooker and Connor McGovern were listed as full participants.

news.h: Chiefs' Kenneth Walker III still sidelined
news.b: Kansas City's Monday estimated report listed RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) as not participating; he has missed the last two games. RT Jaylon Moore (ankle), TE Noah Gray (rib) and FB Ben VanSumeren (knee) also did not practice. G Trey Smith (concussion) was a full participant.

news.h: Bills favored by 3 for Thanksgiving night
news.b: FanDuel had Buffalo as a 3-point favorite over Kansas City (8-2) as of Nov. 23, with the total at 50.5 and the Bills at −149 on the moneyline (Chiefs +126). The 9-1 Bills hold the AFC's No. 1 seed going into the 8:20 p.m. ET kickoff on NBC at Highmark Stadium.

source: Bills and Chiefs Monday estimated injury reports (PFT, Democrat and Chronicle via Yahoo Sports), Fox Sports Thanksgiving odds (FanDuel), AFC East records via Yahoo Sports; earlier recaps from ESPN and AP (checked Nov 24).
